senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (चकते)
To repel, to resist.
(चकति-ते)
To be satiate or satisfied.
2 To shine.

r. 10th cl. (चक्कयति)
To give or inflict pain.

(ऋ) चकासृ r. 2nd cl. (चकास्ति)
To shine.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Beautifying, illuminating.
E.
चकास to shine, causal form, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Illuminated, shining, splendid, beautiful.
E.
चकास, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Timid, fearful.
2 Frightened at, afraid of.
n. (-तं)
Timidity, groundless alarm.
f. (-ता)
A species of the Aṣṭi metre.
E.
चक to repel, affix क्त.

m. (-रः)
The bartavelle or Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa or Tetrao rufus.)
E.
चक to be satisfied, ओरन् Uṇādi affix; also with कन् added चकोरक; what is satisfied with the moonbeams, upon which the bird is fabulously said to subsist.

m. (-कः)
The Greek partridge: see the preceding.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Fine-eyed.
E.
चकोर and दृश the eye.

m. (-सः)
1 Crookedness.
2 Dishonesty.
E.
क्नस to be crooked, अप् affix, and the root repeated.

m. (-क्रः)
1 The ruddy or Brahmani goose, (Anas casarca.)
n. (-क्रं)
1 An army, a host.
2 A realm, a region.
3 A multitude, a heap.
4 A wheel.
5 A potter's wheel.
6 An oil mill, &c.
7 A discus or sharp circular missile weapon.
8 A whirlpool.
9 A province, a number of villages, a district.
10 A form of military array, a circular position.
11 A diagram of various sorts for calculating nativities or foretelling events.
12 A ring, circle or depression of the body for mystical, astrological or cheiromantic purposes; six such are enumerated, or Mūlādhāra the parts about the pubis, above that is the Svādhiṣṭhānam or umbilical region, and above that the Maṇipūram or pit of the stomach or epigastrium, Anāhatam is the root of the nose, Viśuddham the hollow between the frontal sinuses, and the Ājñākhyam the fontenelle or union of the coronal and sagittal sutures; various faculties and divinities are supposed to be present in these hollows.
13 A cycle, a cycle of years.
14 (In Astronomy,) A sphere or circle, as राशिचक्रं the zodiac; प्राक् चक्रं an epicycle.
15 The horizon.
16 The spiral marks of the Śālagrāma or ammonite.
E.
कृ to do or make, with the reduplicate initial letter, affix क, or चक to repel, &c. with रक aff.

m. (-कः)
A logical form or proposition, arguing in a circle.
E.
कन् implying resemblance, added to the last.

m. (-कः)
A kind of perfume, apparently a dried shellfish: see नखी.
E.
चक्र a heap, and कारक what makes.

f. (-ल्या)
A species of fern, commonly Cākuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.)

m. (-ण्डुः)
A round pillow.
E.
चक्र, and गण्डु a pillow.

m. (-च्छः)
A tree, (Jonesia asoca.)
E.
चक्र a wheel, and गुच्छ a cluster.

m. (-कः)
A potter.
E.
चक्र a wheel, and जीवक who lives by; also चक्रजीविन.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
A hog.
E.
चक्र, and दंष्ट्र a tusk, having a curved tusk.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Having a wheel, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 A village or common tumbler or juggler.
2 One who holds a wheel, a discus, &c.
3 The manager or owner of many villages.
4 A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, who is represented as holding a discus in one hand.
5 A snake.
E.
चक्र a wheel, &c. and धर who holds.

m. (-मा)
A pyritic ore of iron: see माक्षिक.
E.
चक्र a wheel, &c. and नामन् appellation.

m. (-टः)
Cassia tora: see चक्रमर्द्दक.
E.
चक्र a wheel, पद्म a lotus, and अट what goes or is.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant commonly Cākuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.)
E.
चक्र a wheel, and पर्ण a leaf, the leaves being nearly round.

m. (-णिः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
चक्र, and पाणि the hand, being always represented with a discus in one hand.

m. (-दः)
1 A carriage.
2 An elephant.
E.
चक्र a wheel, and पाद a foot; also चक्रपादक.

m. (-लः)
1 Superintendent of a province.
2 One who carries a discus.
3 A circle.
4 The horizon.
E.
चक्र, and पाल who or what protects.

n. (-लं)
A missile weapon, a kind of discus.
E.
चक्र, and फल fruit, bearing a discus as it were for fruit.

m. (-वः)
The sun.
E.
चक्र the ruddy goose, and बान्धव a friend; these birds being supposed to couple only in the day time.

m. (-भृत्)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
चक्र a discus, and भृत् who cherishes: see चक्रपाणि, &c.

f. (-नी)
Night.
E.
चक्र the ruddy goose, and भेदिनी what divides, (male and female); these birds being condemned, according to the Hindus, to be separated at night.

m. (-ली)
A large snake, (Boa constrictor.)
E.
चक्र a wheel, and मण्डल a circumference, implying either that the body of the snake, or the spots on the body may be compared to a wheel.

m. (-र्द्दः)
Cassia tora.
E.
चक्र a wheel, here meaning figuratively a large leprous spot, and मर्द्दं what cleanses or removes, from मृद with अच् added; or with वुन् affix चक्रमर्द्दक.

m. (-कः)
See the preceding.

m. (-खः)
A hog.
E.
चक्र a discus, and मुख face; cutting the ground as it were with a sharp weapon.

n. (-नं)
Any wheel carriage.
E.
क्षक्र a wheel, and यान a carriage.

m. (-दः)
A hog, a boar.
E.
चक्र, and रद a tooth or tusk: see चक्रमुख.

f. (-णा)
A plant, (Menispermum glabrum): see गुडूची.

f. (-ला)
A plant, (Kyllinga monocephala.)
E.
चक्र a wheel, and ल what gets.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Circular, being in a ring or circle.
2 Armed with a discus.
3 Wheeled, &c.
m. (-वान्)
1 The proprietor of an oil mill, or any one in which seeds are bruised.
2 VIṢṆU.
3 An emperor.
E.
चक्र a wheel, &c. मतुप् poss. aff.

ind.
In rotation, going round or revolving like a wheel.
E.
चक्र, and वति aff.

m. (-र्त्ती)
An emperor, a sovereign of the world, the ruler of a Cakra or country described as extending from sea to sea; twelve princes beginning with Bharata are especially considered as Cakravartīs.
E.
चक्र a reign, and वृत to abide, affix इनि.

f. (-नी)
A fragrant plant, commonly Cakāvat.
E.
चक्र a heap, and वर्त्तिन् what abides or grows, fem. affix ङीष्.

m. (-कः)
The ruddy goose, commonly called in India, the Brahmany duck or goose, (Anas casarca.)
E.
चक्र an imitative sound, and वाक speech.

m. (-टः)
1 Limit, boundary.
2 A lamp stand.
3 Engaging in any action.
E.
चक्र, and वट to surround, affix घञ्.

m. (-डः)
See चक्रवाल.

m. (-तः)
A whirlwind, a hurricane.
E.
चक्र a circle, and वात wind.

m. (-लः)
A range of mountains supposed to encircle the earth, and to be the limit of light and darkness.
n. (-लं)
The sensible horizon.
E.
चक्र a region, वल to encompass, and अण् affix; girding the world; or वाड to emerge, &c. affix अच्, what emerges (from darkness), in the shape of a wheel; ड changed to ल; also चक्रवाड.

m. (-हः)
The circular array of troops.
E.
चक्र and व्यूह array.

f. (-द्धिः)
Compound interest.
E.
चक्र a wheel, वृद्धि increase.

f. (-णी)
A plant bearing a crooked fruit: see अजशृङ्गी.
E.
चक्र a wheel, and श्रेणी a line or row.

n. (-ज्ञं)
Tin.
E.
चक्र, and सज्ञा a name.

m. (-रः)
The name of a Bauddha deity; also हेरम्ब.
E.
चक्र a discus, and सम्बर who holds.

m. (-स्तः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
चक्र, and हस्त hand: holding a discus.

f. (-ङ्की)
A wild goose.
E.
चक्र a number, and अकि to go, affixes अच् and ङीप्, flying in large flocks.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A gander.
2 A carriage.
f. (-ङ्गी)
1 A goose.
2 A drug: see कटुकि.
3 A potherb, (Hilancha repens): see हिलमोचिका.
E.
चक्र a wheel, &c. and अङ्ग a limb or the body.

m. (-टः)
1 A juggler, a snake-catcher, one who exhibits snakes and pretends to cure their bites.
2 A knave, a cheat, a rogue.
3 A gold coin or certain weight of gold, a Dīnāra.
E.
चक्र a number of villages, and अट who goes, i. e. a vagabond, &c.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Doing.
2 Done.
E.
कृ to do, कानच् aff.

m. (-सी)
The orange tree.
E.
चक्र a heap, and अधिवस to abide, णिनि aff.

m. (-र्त्तः)
Turning round, whirling or rotatory motion.
E.
चक्र a wheel, and आवर्त्त revolving.

m. (-क्रिः)
An agent, a maker, a doer.
E.
कृ to do, कि affix, the root reduplicate and the deriv. irr.

f. (का)
The knee.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Circular.
2 Belonging to a wheel or discus.
3 Relating to a company or circle.
m. (-कः)
1 A chorister, a bard who chaunts in chorus the praises of kings. heroes, gods, &c.
2 An oil maker.
3 A coachman, a driver.
E.
चक्र a multitude, &c. and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-क्री-क्रिणी-क्रि)
1 Having or holding a discus, &c.
2 Wheeled, having a wheel.
3 Circular.
m. (-क्री)
1 A name of VIṢṆU.
2 A potter.
3 The ruddy goose.
4 A snake.
5 An informer.
6 A tumbler, one who exhibits tricks with a discus or a wheel.
7 An oil grinder.
8 An emperor, a Cakravartī: see चक्रवर्त्तिन्.
9 One who rides in a carriage.
10 A crow.
11 An ass.
12 Cassia, (the tree.)
E.
चक्र a wheel, &c. and इनि poss. aff.

m. (-वान्)
1 An ass.
2 The name of a king.
E.
चक्र a wheel, वतु affix, and deriv. irr. rolling over like a wheel.

m. (-क्रुः)
An agent, a maker, a doer.
E.
कृ to make or do, with the reduplicate initial, and कु Uṇādi aff.

f. (-री)
A female deity peculiar to the Jainas, one of their Vidyā Devis or goddesses of wisdom.
E.
चक्र the universe, and ईश्वरी mistress.

(इङ्) चक्षिङ् r. 2nd cl. (चष्टे)
1 To speak, to tell.
2 To see; (in this sense आङ् is usually prefixed)
3 To eat. ख्या or क्श are substituted for the radical letters in several tenses of this verb.

n. (-णं)
1 Eating a relish to promote drinking.
2 Speaking, saying.
E.
चक्ष to speak, to eat, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-क्षाः)
1 A name of VṚHASPATI the preceptor of the gods.
2 A spiritual teacher, an instructor in sacred science.
E.
चक्ष to speak, affix असुन्.

m. (-वाः)
A snake.
E.
चक्षुस् an eye, and श्रवस् an ear; whose eyes are ears.

n. (-नं)
The ceremony of anointing the eyes of the image at the time of consecration.
E.
चक्षुस्, and दान giving.

m. (-यः-यं)
1 Presence, sight.
2 An object of sight, any visible object.
3 Visibility.
E.
चक्षुस्, and विषय object.

mfn. (-ष्मान्-ष्मन्ती-ष्मत्)
1 Having eyes, seeing.
2 Having fine eyes.
E.
चक्षुस्, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
1 Beautiful, pleasing or well looking.
2 Fit or agreeable for the eyes.
m. (-ष्यः)
1 A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)
2 A plant: see पुण्डराक.
3 A collyrium or application to the eyes, extracted from the Amomum anthorhiza. []
f. (-ष्या)
1 A blue stone, or according to some, the calx of brass used as collyrium.
2 A pleasing or interesting woman.
E.
चक्षुस् the eye, affix यत्.

n. (-क्षुः)
The eye.
E.
चक्ष to speak, and उसि aff.

m. (-गः)
Ophthalmia.
E.
चक्षुस्, and रोग disease.

mfn. (-षः-षी-षं)
Visible, perceptible, seen.
m. (-षः)
The sixth Manu.
E.
चक्षुष the eye, अण् aff.
